places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Jake comes sulking into the Dry Bean and takes Lorena upstairs; she resolves to be done with the town and wants to leave tomorrow.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande; Mexico visible from Lorena's window

places.name: Rio Grande
places.note: Jake, gritty from cattle work, says he should have washed in it.

places.name: Montana
places.note: Jake complains his friends expect him to help drive cattle there just because he mentioned it.

places.name: San Francisco
places.note: Lorena insists Jake keep his promise to take her there.

places.name: Red River
places.note: Jake jokes he'd have to shoot half the lovestruck cowboys before reaching it if Lorena came along.

places.name: Mexico
places.note: Jake considers fleeing across the river but judges it even more violent than Texas.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Jake reflects that Texans and Mexicans keep hanging each other's people.

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: If he must hang, Jake would rather it be there; he wonders if Lorena might kill the Arkansas sheriff for him.

places.name: Cheyenne
places.note: Jake once outwitted a simple-hearted redheaded prostitute there.

places.name: San Antonio
places.note: Jake suggests going there to gamble; Lorena refuses because Tinkersley once took her there.

places.name: Austin
places.note: Offered by Jake as an easier alternative to San Francisco.

places.name: Fort Worth
places.note: Another nearer town Jake proposes instead of San Francisco.

places.name: Denver
places.note: Jake talks of reaching it and then crossing over to San Francisco.

places.name: Bighorn Mountains
places.note: Jake likens Lorena's remoteness to these mountains, which seem to come no closer however long one rides.

groups.label: Jake and Lorena
groups.hint: in Lorena's room above the Dry Bean saloon
